feeds.title: Africa Hunting
feeds.description: Since 2007, AfricaHunting.com is the place to go for online discussions of all things related to hunting worldwide. Find everything you need to know to embark on an African hunting safari; get detailed planning information, connect with reputable hunting outfitters and service providers to avoid costly mistakes.

feeds.title: African Hunting Safaris Blog
feeds.description: We pride ourselves in offering personalized, tailored Hunting Safaris in Africa. We cater to single hunters, groups, and families in our hunting areas in Southern Africa. We specialize in big game hunting, from Dangerous games to the 'tiny ten'. We offer Hunting and Photographic Safaris in neighboring countries such as Mozambique.

feeds.title: Karoo Wild Safaris Hunters Blog
feeds.description: Explore our hunting blog to know more about hunting in South Africa, animals to hunt, gear to carry and more! Karoo Wild Safaris promises an exceptional South Africa plains game hunting safari. Family owned and managed, we have extensive knowledge in hunting and hospitality. We offer hunters and families a hunting and vacation experience of a lifetime.

feeds.title: Book Your Hunt Blog » Africa
feeds.description: Check out our articles for hunting trips in Africa. Founded in 2015, BookYourHunt is a trusted online marketplace where hunters, outdoor enthusiasts, and professional outfitters can list, easily discover, book, and enjoy unique hunting opportunities around the world. Whether a hunter is looking for a local hunting trip near home, a long-dreamed-of African safari, or a last-minute cancellation hunt at a discount, BookYourHunt connects its users to unique hunting opportunities, whatever their budgets, in more than 54 countries across 5 continents.

feeds.title: Otjandaue Hunting Safaris Blog
feeds.description: Otjandaue Hunting Ranch is a private trophy hunting ranch in Namibia owned and operated by Roy and Janet Van der Merwe with their two daughters Rune and Kaylin. We want your trophy hunting safari to be a memorable experience. We'll make you comfortable in our lodge that's built on the banks of the Otjandaue river bed.

feeds.title: John X Safaris Blog
feeds.description: Hunting with John X Safaris is more than just a hunt - It's the total safari experience. It is a journey of discovery, the awakening of the senses, and ultimately the realization of the dream of hunting Africa. With over three decades of experience in the safari industry, you can rest assured you are in safe hands when booking a hunt with John X Safaris.

feeds.title: Huntershill Safaris
feeds.description: We are committed to animal conservation, fair chase hunting, and giving our guests a thrilling experience to make your hunt a memorable one. We specialize in making your hunting Safari an experience of a lifetime. Our Safaris are led by experienced professional hunters and trackers who conduct both rifle and bow-hunting safaris.

feeds.title: Hunting Limpopo South Africa Blog
feeds.description: I am Magnus Crossberg owner and PH of Ranchero Safaris. We are hunting outfitters in Limpopo. My mission is to provide you with the best possible adventure safari in Limpopo and my goal is to ensure that every client visiting Ranchero Safaris has an amazing experience and sees us as family.

feeds.title: Peter Flack Blog
feeds.description: When I look back over the last 59 years of my hunting career, with a crystal clear vision of hindsight, I can see how inevitable it was that I would end up in my current situation.

feeds.title: Big Water Safaris Blog
feeds.description: Big Water Safaris offer fair chase hunting safaris on the 33 000ha (80 000 acre) Laohu Valley Reserve which is situated in Central South Africa. We offer trophy hunting as well as cull hunting. All hunting is conducted on foot and all hunters are guided by experienced professional hunters. Hunters are accommodated in a luxurious, renovated farm house.
